name: taskflow
title_zh: 任务从需求到归档全程留痕的项目流程管家
tagline_zh: 非小事才配走它：澄清需求、写PRD、拆规格、排实施、验结果、记会话、归档。每一步都产出可追溯的工件。
tagline_en: For non-trivial work: PRD, spec decision, plan, verification, session log, archive. Every phase leaves durable.
desc_en: Manage a task through the project's task-directory workflow: clarify requirements, create PRD, decide whether a large task needs a Spec, plan implementation, verify results, record sessions, and archive completed work. Use for non-trivial feature, bug, refactor, research, or documentation tasks that need durable task artifacts.
why_zh: 把隐性决策显性化：每个阶段强制产出物，让任务中途换人、复盘、追溯都有据可查，而非依赖口头同步。
why_en: Forces explicit checkpoints so handoffs, audits, and post-mortems read from files, not memory. Process overhead buys traceability.
limit_zh: 只服务仓库内已有task目录规范的项目；单文件小改动、纯问答型任务会嫌它重。不自动执行代码或测试，只编排流程与记录。
limit_en: Requires an existing task/ directory convention. Overkill for one-line fixes or Q&A. Does not run code/tests—only orchestrates workflow and records.
title_en: Task lifecycle manager: clarify, spec, implement, verify.
